title: DynamicsParams
description: Macro dynamics parameters. SPEC-SIM-5: Phillips-curve / IS-curve model knobs.

phillips_slope.description: Slope of the Phillips curve: how much unemployment gap reduces inflation per month.

rate_sensitivity.description: How much unemployment changes per month per unit of rate gap (policy_rate - neutral_rate).

neutral_rate.description: The neutral nominal policy rate at which unemployment is neither rising nor falling.

inflation_persistence.description: Weight on lagged inflation in the inflation update equation (0 = no persistence, 1 = full persistence).
